end.summary: Discussed when exact values or approximate values are appropriate.
end.parentNote: Asha practised choosing exact or approximate values and rounding large numbers to the nearest thousand, lakh, or crore. Ayaan explained that crowd sizes can be approximate while bank balances and online fees need exact values. They initially mixed up which digit to check when rounding, then used the place-value rule across later examples; all four rounding attempts were unaided correct. At home, ask Ayaan to explain which digit they check before rounding everyday numbers such as prices or distances.
